title: Adjacent-seam output intervals empty a successor type or make the bounded (a,r) graph a DAG
statement: The output interval of a feasible block O^a E^r is an input constraint on the next seam that empties a transition (a',r') both independent prefix tests 2^{a+r}<=3^a and 2^{a'+r'}<=3^{a'} allow, other than the archived cheap-OOE adjacency at v=n, or the finite type graph on bounded CycleMin-legal (a,r) is a directed acyclic graph.
counterexamples: 81 independently allowed pairs on the wide hull [3,10^6+1], the CycleMin tube [10^6+1,10^6+4001], and the middle a>=1 table: n_new_empty=0
cheap OOE at 1000057 lands at 5623773 < oe_start_min(10^6+1)=100000135; two OOE land at 39244721; both are ooe_blocks_oe / two_ooe_still_blocks_oe
realized type graph on [13,2001): 48 nodes, 214 edges, OOE self-loop, max out-degree 30; CycleMin-shaped subgraph 17 nodes, 41 edges, also cyclic
log-width ratio of block_image equals rho (9/8 and 3/4); block-level C_{k+1}=C_1 is not strictly stronger than propagate_cycle
notes: Phase 0 only. Not a halt theorem and not a leftover-killer. Composed hulls do not empty independently allowed successors. The type graph is cyclic and multi-valued. Interval shrink is the closed exponent budget. Block-level cyclic closure is a coarsening of propagate_cycle. No finance, no K=11, no L=55293, no floor raise. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no new Lean.
tested_range: prefix tables a<=6, r<=4; CycleMin tube at n=10^6+1 with first OOE start 1000057; realized transitions on odds in [13,2001); shrink on [1001,3001] and [10^6+1,10^6+4001]; cyclic closure on OOOOEE, OOOOOOEEE, OOEOOEOOEOE
